evidence_authority_rules.verification_check: That check recorded unresolved/noncorroboration, not proof all documents are physically absent.
evidence_authority_rules.complete_input_inventory: Scoped exhaustive absence across supplied snapshot; not repaired by candidate citations.
evidence_authority_rules.code: Implemented fixed rules and constraints; not an independent runtime trace.
evidence_authority_rules.output_contract: Required flags and output shape; not proof of completed review.
evidence_authority_rules.frozen_output: What candidate actually said; not evidence that assertions are true.
evidence_authority_rules.packet_manifest: Recorded artifacts and matching repeat bytes; not independent execution certification.
evidence_authority_rules.owner_review: Methodological and synthetic adjudication in this conversation, not AML expert review.
